atAGlance: Chả cá Lã Vọng is Hanoi-style turmeric fish with dill and scallions, eaten with rice vermicelli, peanuts, herbs, and usually mắm tôm or a milder fish-sauce dip.
whatItIs: Chả cá Lã Vọng is Hanoi-style turmeric fish cooked with dill and scallions, eaten with vermicelli, herbs, peanuts, and usually mắm tôm or fish-sauce dip.
howToEnjoy: Mix fish, dill, noodles, herbs, and peanuts in small bites. Try mắm tôm carefully first; it is fermented, strong, and central to the classic version.
howLocalsOrder: Order chả cá Lã Vọng when you want the Hanoi turmeric-dill fish experience. Ask for fish-sauce dip instead of mắm tôm if fermented shrimp paste feels too strong.
worthKnowing: Dill is not a garnish here; it is cooked in abundance with Hanoi-style turmeric fish.
goodToKnow: This is not fish cake. The famous version is about hot turmeric-marinated fish and dill at the table.
commonOptions: fish-sauce dip instead of mắm tôm
travelerCaution: May contain peanuts and shrimp paste.
